title: Product Manager I
description:
Responsibilities:

Are you a driven and ambitious individual looking to make an impact in the world of Information Technology? Principal is seeking a Product Manager I to join our team in Pune, Maharashtra, India. This is a unique opportunity to work with a world-class team and be part of exciting and innovative projects that shape the future of our technology landscape!

Job Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Execution

* Partner with Product Management and Engineering leadership to understand PDIO strategy and drive execution within agreed priorities.
* Convert the PDIO vision into well-defined product outcomes, roadmap priorities, and quantifiable opportunities.
* Develop a solid grasp of the developer journey, engineering workflows, SDLC methods, and challenges faced by product delivery teams.
* Ensure relationships and dependencies across developer platforms, engineering methods, tooling, data, and delivery processes are understood and reflected in product decisions.
* Integrate developer, engineering, product, and collaborator insights to build a shared understanding of the highest-value problems to solve.

Product Discovery & Developer Experience

* Recognize and assess opportunities to advance Developer Experience (DX), engineering productivity, software delivery flow, quality, and reliability.
* Partner with engineers, delivery managers, product managers, and other collaborators to understand workflow friction and determine root causes.
* Develop hypotheses and collaborate with engineering teams on experiments and solutions.
* Use quantitative DX signals alongside qualitative team feedback to distinguish symptoms from meaningful problems worth solving.
* Assess experiment results and use findings to inform backlog and roadmap prioritization.
* Help establish an effective parallel discovery and delivery model for PDIO.

Product Delivery

* Take responsibility for the successful delivery of measurable, goal-aligned PDIO outcomes in collaboration with engineering and other technology teams.
* Own and refine the product roadmap and prioritized backlog for assigned PDIO capabilities.
* Transform validated opportunities into well-defined product requirements, outcomes, success measures, stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Work together with the team to divide tasks into smaller parts that allow for regular delivery and learning.
* Identify and help resolve dependencies and impediments affecting product outcomes.
* Engage fully in Agile ceremonies and join the team in ongoing efforts to refine delivery approaches.
* Communicate product releases, changes, and resulting value to collaborators and partners.

Product Measurement, DX & Engineering Intelligence

* Use DX, DORA, and SDLC metrics to understand product health, developer friction, delivery performance, and opportunities for improvement.
* Review dashboards weekly or per sprint to identify hotspots, trends, rework, lead-time indicators, blocked work, and cross-team handoff delays.
* Bring relevant signals into retrospectives, planning, and team reflection conversations.
* Use team health, snapshot results, negative themes, and satisfaction trends in combination with workflow measures to form a balanced understanding of developer experience.
* Partner with teams to co-create measurable improvement goals and promote experimentation and small changes.
* Evaluate whether PDIO capabilities produce measurable improvements in engineering effectiveness and developer experience.
* Use data to guide discovery, prioritization, investment decisions, and roadmap adjustments.

Collaborator Management & Communication

* Develop solid connections with Product Management, Engineering, Delivery Management, Platform Engineering, Architecture, Security, and other technology collaborators.
* Communicate PDIO strategy, priorities, roadmap, experiments, product performance, and outcomes clearly to collaborators.
* Develop shared understanding between engineering teams and supporting enterprise functions.
* Balance competing needs and prioritize opportunities based on expected developer and business value.
* Help collaborators understand and prepare product and process changes.

Qualifications:

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or related fields, or equivalent professional experience (B.E. / B.Tech / M.S. / M.Tech / MCA).
* Total Experience: 8-10 Years with more than 3 years of background in Product Management, technical product management, software ecosystems, engineering efficiency, or similar roles preferred.

Must Have

* Strong product discovery, roadmap planning, backlog prioritization, and Agile delivery skills.
* Strong collaborator management and communication skills, particularly when working across technical, product development, and engineering teams.
* Ability to convert complex technical concepts and engineering data into clear product opportunities, priorities, outcomes, and value.
* Analytical problem-solving skills and a committed, ownership approach.
* High agency and initiative: ability to translate agreed strategy and direction into action, proactively advance progress, and take ownership of outcomes without close supervision or daily prompting.

Preferred to Have

* Product Management experience working with Developer Platforms, Developer Experience (DX), Engineering Productivity, Platform Engineering, or similar technical products.
* Deep knowledge of Developer Experience concepts and DORA metrics, combined with the skill to convert engineering indicators into product insights and possibilities for improvement.
* Experience with GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and SDLC governance sufficient to product-manage capabilities across the engineering lifecycle.
* Experience using ServiceNow in the context of Agile delivery, process improvements, and incident management.
* Familiarity with Snowflake and experience interpreting data to guide product decisions, prioritization, and evaluation.

Additional Information:

Join us at Principal and contribute to our mission of achieving world-class excellence in product delivery and innovation!

**This role is** **Office Based, Pune Office**

Job Description | Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experience

Location: India / In Person Team: Cornerstone University

  

**About Cornerstone:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

  

**About the role:**

Today, our customers and partners learn through Cornerstone University training and courses, our knowledge base, live events, community forums, certifications, and conversations with their Customer Success team. These experiences are centralized through the Cornerstone Community, but they live in separate systems and can feel like separate journeys.

As Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experiences, you will define and own the enablement platforms vision, strategy, architecture, and execution for one unified Cornerstone University experience: a single front door where customers, partners, and employees find answers, connect with experts and peers, learn in the flow of their work, and prove what they can do. You’ll see where information flows, where it breaks, and where the opportunities are, and you’ll turn that into a roadmap, an architecture, and shipped experiences that drive customer adoption, partner readiness, and renewal.

This is a senior, high-ownership role: one part product leader, one part architect, one part builder. You’ll report to the leader of Enablement & Community Experiences, who owns the business outcomes for the function. You own the platform that delivers them. You’ll also act as Customer Zero for Cornerstone’s own Workforce AI and learning technology, running our education business on our own products and feeding what we learn back to Product.

The role joins Cornerstone at an exciting moment, helping shape the company’s future through our Workforce AI tools. This is a new role on the Cornerstone University team for someone with clear vision, sound judgment, and the cross-functional leadership to bring bold ideas to life.

This role is based in India, with teammates based in global geographic hubs. Weekday hours require flexing to provide overlap with members in EMEA and the Americas.

  

**Scope and Decision Rights:**

* **You own:** Cornerstone University product roadmap; prioritization; target-state architecture and standards; integrations and data flows; design and build of AI-powered experiences; build-vs-buy recommendations and vendor evaluations; technical direction for learning system administrators.
* **You partner on:** enablement and community strategy, program priorities, budget, and executive alignment, content (Learning Design & Content) measurement and insights (Strategy, Insights & Operations); identity and security (IT and Security); CRM and customer health data (Salesforce and Gainsight teams).
  

**In this role, you will…**

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Platform Vision, Strategy & Product Management*

* Define and own the platform vision and multi-year roadmap for the Cornerstone University ecosystem (learning platforms, community, knowledge base, certifications, events, in-product learning, and AI experiences), tied directly to customer adoption and retention, partner readiness, and education as a growth function.
* Map the current customer learning landscape, including platforms, data flows, identity, content, search, and handoffs, and identify where users hit friction, fragmentation, duplication, or unnecessary cost.
* Run continuous product discovery with customers, partners, Customer Success, Services, and Support. Prioritize by business impact and say no clearly.
* Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions and platform vendor strategy, backed by business cases. Evaluate vendor roadmaps and market shifts in customer education and community platforms.
* Present the platform roadmap, investment cases, and trade-offs to executives in clear business language.

*Architecture & Standards*

* Define the target-state architecture and standards for the learning ecosystem, including data models, integration patterns, identity and SSO design, content and search, and security and privacy. Partner with Product, IT, and Security to put them into practice.
* Own the shared taxonomy and metadata framework covering products, skills, roles, audiences, and content types, as the foundation for search, personalized learning paths, reporting, and AI retrieval.
* Instrument the ecosystem: define event-level learning telemetry (e.g., xAPI and a learning record store) and data pipelines so learning, community, and certification activity can be measured at account and capability level and connected to adoption, retention, and revenue.
* Ensure the experience is accessible, localized, and performs well for a global audience.

*AI-Powered Experiences*

* Lead the strategy, design, and build of AI-powered experiences across Cornerstone University and Community, such as an authenticated answer experience that blends learning, community, and support content; personalized learning paths and nudges; and AI-assisted practice and assessment. Use native Cornerstone AI first and third-party solutions where justified.
* Own the retrieval approach behind these experiences, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a governed content corpus, permission-aware retrieval, and content freshness, working closely with Content and Product teams.
* Establish evaluation and responsible AI practices: accuracy and hallucination testing, guardrails, human-in-the-loop review, privacy, and cost monitoring.
* Design for an agentic future, including integration through emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and partner agent ecosystems.

*Integration & Execution*

* Own and drive the integrations between the learning ecosystem including Cornerstone platform, Salesforce and Gainsight so learning, community, and certification data syncs to the right account and contact records and appears in Customer Success, Sales, and partner workflows, giving a complete picture of adoption, health, and renewal.
* Lead delivery of platform programs end to end: plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, vendor and implementation-partner management, testing, launch, and change management.
* Own the certification and credentialing platform infrastructure, including proctored exams, digital badges, and certification maintenance and renewal flows, in partnership with the Certification team.
* Deliver learning in the flow of work, including in-product guidance within Cornerstone and experiences embedded in the tools customers, partners, and employees already use.
* Set technical priorities for learning system administrators, review configuration decisions, evaluate platform changes, and define release and testing standards.

*Partnership & Leadership*

* Partner with your manager to translate business goals into platform priorities and to report progress and outcomes.
* Work across Cornerstone University, Customer Success, Services, Support, Alliances, Product, Marketing, and IT.
* Act as Customer Zero: run Cornerstone University on Cornerstone products and give structured feedback to Product.
* Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and executives.
  

**What Success Looks Like:**

* **First 30-60 days:** current-state map, target-state architecture, prioritized roadmap, and investment case agreed with leadership; quick wins identified and underway.
* **By 6 months:** unified identity and single front door in delivery; agentic experiences serving 60+% of the audience’s needs through agentic front door, learning and community data flowing to Salesforce and Gainsight account records at an agreed data-quality level; telemetry standards in place; first AI experience piloting with defined success metrics.
* **By 9-12 months:** single front door live for customers and partners serving 80+% of the needs; AI answer experience in production with measured resolution and satisfaction; fewer platforms and lower platform cost; learning engagement visible in account health and used by Customer Success; certification infrastructure supporting proctored, role-based credentials at scale.
* **Ongoing measures:** front-door adoption, time to answer, integration reliability, data quality, AI resolution rate, and platform cost, plus clear contribution to customer adoption, retention, and partner readiness.

**You've Got What It Takes If You Have…**

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 10+ years in learning technology, customer education, or enterprise SaaS platforms, including significant time as a platform owner, product manager, or architect who set strategy, not only configured tools.
* Proven ownership of a multi-platform learning ecosystem. You were accountable for the vision, architecture, integrations, and roadmap across learning, community, knowledge, and certification platforms, with evidence that it improved customer and business outcomes.
* Product management depth: discovery, prioritization, road mapping, business cases, build vs. buy decisions, and adoption metrics.
* A track record of leading large-scale, multi-system implementations or consolidations from strategy through delivery, including vendors and cross-functional teams.
* Deep integration experience across learning systems and Salesforce CRM, including REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, SSO (SAML/OIDC), data syncs, and learning standards (SCORM, xAPI, cmi5, LTI).
* Hands-on expertise with at least one enterprise or customer education LMS, preferably Cornerstone, or Skilljar, Docebo, Thought Industries, Intellum, Absorb, or similar.
* AI shipped in production: you have designed and delivered at least one AI-powered experience (e.g., agents, RAG-based answers, or AI workflows) used by real users with measured outcomes, and can speak to evaluation, guardrails, data governance, and cost.
* Ability to set strategy independently and communicate it at executive level.
* Comfort moving between strategy and configuration in the same day.
  

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Experience integrating online community platforms (Gainsight preferred), including SSO, data, and how learning and community intersect.
* Experience with Gainsight or similar customer success platforms and customer health data.
* Customer and partner education experience at a B2B SaaS company, including certification programs.
* Experience with agent interoperability standards (such as MCP) and enterprise AI platforms.
* Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Integration Architect).
  

**How You Work:**

* **Customer obsessed:** you start from the learner’s and the account’s problem, not the tool.
* **Innovate and transform:** you challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that don’t earn their place.
* **Proactive leadership:** you see the problem and act before you’re asked.
* **Get it done:** you ship, measure, and iterate.
* **Forward looking:** you plan for where the technology and the business are going, not where they have been.
* **AI native:** you use AI every day to rethink your own work, not just to speed it up.
* **Get uncomfortable to succeed:** you take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

About the Role
  
  
The Senior Manager, Real-Time Operations and Workforce Management will build and lead a new 24/7 Real-Time Operations Center in Pune, India. This leader will establish the processes, operating rhythms, tools, and team capabilities required to manage intraday workforce performance across a global Support organization.
  
The role combines WFM expertise with strong operational leadership. The Senior Manager will oversee real-time staffing, schedule execution, adherence, shrinkage, queue health, and live customer demand across calls and case work. Using NICE CXone WFM and Salesforce, this leader will ensure emerging risks are identified early, decisions are made quickly, and actions are coordinated with Support leadership, WFM planning, and frontline managers.
  
This leader will also help translate broader Customer Experience priorities and the Operational Rigor framework into practical daily operating mechanisms. The goal is to improve visibility, accountability, service protection, productivity, and customer outcomes while freeing frontline managers to focus on case progression, coaching, quality, employee development, and customer commitments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Real-Time Operations Center Leadership
  

* Build and operationalize the Real-Time Operations Center, including its staffing model, coverage plan, role clarity, shift structure, handoff routines, escalation paths, and management cadences.
* Lead and develop a distributed 24/7 team of Real-Time Operations Specialists, establishing expectations for decision quality, responsiveness, documentation, communication, and customer-impact awareness.
* Create a culture of ownership, urgency, analytical thinking, and disciplined execution in which the Center actively protects service and customer outcomes rather than simply reporting conditions.

Intraday Workforce Management and Service Protection
  

* Oversee intraday monitoring and intervention across global Support operations, including staffing levels, queue conditions, contact volumes, case backlogs, service levels, productivity, occupancy, and emerging demand or capacity gaps.
* Use NICE CXone WFM to monitor schedules against actual activity, manage real-time adherence, identify late starts, absences, extended AUX states, and other deviations, and coordinate approved schedule or coverage changes.
* Establish response playbooks for staffing shortages, unexpected volume, shrinkage events, system disruption, high-priority customer demand, backlog risk, and other business-continuity situations.
* Ensure the Center monitors both live calls and Salesforce case queues so customer demand is managed across channels and work types rather than through a voice-only lens.

Operational Rigor and Process Design
  

* Design and continuously improve standard operating procedures, decision rights, escalation matrices, shift handoffs, incident routines, and evidence-based operating practices for real-time management.
* Partner with WFM leadership to align real-time execution with forecasting, scheduling, skill-group consolidation, shift optimization, heat maps, capacity models, and broader workforce planning.
* Help standardize AUX codes, shrinkage categories, schedule adherence practices, queue definitions, reporting logic, and operational terminology across Support business units.
* Develop dashboards, daily views, interval reporting, and recurring operational communications that create a reliable single source of truth for managers and leaders.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Customer Experience
  

* Partner with Support Services, WFM, Ready, Pro, Pro WFM, Operations, Technology, Product, and other stakeholders to align real-time actions to customer experience priorities and business commitments.
* Translate operational signals into clear recommendations, decisions, and escalations for Support leaders, including the likely effect on customer wait time, case aging, service level, resolution speed, and employee experience.
* Ensure real-time operations are connected to the broader Ops Rigor framework, including customer outcomes, operational health and flow, management routines, governance, and accountability.
* Represent the Real-Time Operations Center in operating reviews and transformation forums, bringing forward patterns, systemic gaps, and opportunities to improve the Support operating model.

Analytics, Governance, and Change Adoption
  

* Define and monitor performance measures such as schedule adherence, shrinkage, occupancy, queue and case service levels, staffing variance, productivity, backlog risk, escalation response, and data quality.
* Establish inspection and review routines that distinguish planned schedules from actual AUX activity and reinforce accurate, timely operational data.
* Lead change adoption for new WFM processes, CXone capabilities, Salesforce operational views, and real-time management routines, ensuring changes are understood and embedded into daily work.
* Use trends and root-cause analysis to recommend improvements to staffing, skills, processes, technology, and cross-functional ownership.

Basic Qualifications
  

* 8+ years of experience in workforce management, contact center operations, customer support operations, real-time management, or a related operational leadership field.
* Demonstrated experience leading intraday or real-time operations in a complex, multi-site, multi-channel contact center or enterprise support environment.
* Strong working knowledge of WFM disciplines, including forecasting and scheduling partnership, real-time adherence, shrinkage, occupancy, staffing variance, service levels, and interval management.
* Experience using NICE CXone WFM, NICE IEX, or a comparable enterprise WFM and ACD platform. Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud or comparable case-management tooling is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to build operating models, standard operating procedures, escalation frameworks, dashboards, and governance routines from the ground up.
* Strong people leadership, executive communication, analytical reasoning, and decision-making skills in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant WFM, contact center, or operations certification preferred.

  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience launching or transforming a command center, real-time operations center, or centralized intraday management function.
* Experience managing global operations across multiple regions, time zones, languages, channels, skill groups, or business units.
* Experience with workforce capacity models, interval forecasting, heat maps, business-continuity planning, and operational reporting.
* Experience driving change management, workforce discipline, and adoption of standardized operating practices across distributed teams.

  
Success Profile
  
  
The ideal candidate is a builder and operator who can create structure without slowing the business down. This leader combines contact-center WFM expertise with sound judgment, clear communication, and a strong customer lens. They are comfortable making time-sensitive decisions with incomplete information, escalating appropriately, and turning real-time signals into coordinated action. They will be measured not only by the accuracy of reports, but by whether the Center helps Support leaders act earlier, protect customer experience, improve workforce discipline, and create a more predictable operating environment.

About Osumare Marketing Solutions

Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a full-service branding and digital marketing agency specializing in performance marketing, SEO, social media management, branding, website development, creative strategy, and digital growth solutions.

We manage digital marketing campaigns for clients across multiple industries, helping businesses generate qualified leads, acquire customers, increase sales, and achieve measurable growth through data-driven marketing strategies.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced, analytical, and result-oriented Paid Ads Manager who can independently plan, execute, manage, optimize, and scale paid advertising campaigns across multiple platforms.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete performance marketing lifecycle, from understanding client business objectives and developing media plans to campaign setup, audience targeting, budget allocation, conversion tracking, optimization, reporting, and performance improvement.

The ideal candidate must have hands-on expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads, along with experience in e-commerce advertising, Google Shopping campaigns, remarketing, lead generation, and conversion-focused campaigns.

The candidate should be capable of managing multiple client accounts, handling advertising budgets responsibly, identifying performance improvement opportunities, and delivering measurable results while maintaining campaign profitability and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities1. Paid Advertising Strategy & Planning

* Develop comprehensive paid advertising strategies aligned with client objectives, target audiences, and business goals.
* Understand client products, services, target markets, sales processes, and customer acquisition requirements.
* Prepare media plans, advertising budgets, channel allocations, campaign structures, and performance forecasts.
* Identify the most suitable advertising platforms based on campaign objectives, audience behaviour, and industry requirements.
* Develop strategies for lead generation, e-commerce sales, website traffic, brand awareness, app promotion, and customer acquisition.
* Establish campaign KPIs such as cost per lead (CPL), cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), conversion rate, and customer acquisition cost (CAC).
* Conduct competitor research, keyword research, audience research, and advertising opportunity analysis.

2. Google Ads Management

* Independently plan, set up, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns.
* Manage Search, Display, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, and remarketing campaigns as applicable.
* Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, negative keyword management, and search term optimization.
* Develop effective campaign structures, ad groups, bidding strategies, and conversion-focused ad copy.
* Optimize Quality Score, click-through rate (CTR), cost per click (CPC), conversion rates, and cost per acquisition.
* Manage Google Merchant Center feeds and product advertising for relevant e-commerce accounts.
* Analyze search terms, impression share, auction insights, and campaign-level performance.
* Identify wasted advertising spend and implement corrective actions to improve efficiency.
* Stay updated on Google Ads features, automation capabilities, policies, and campaign best practices.

3. Meta Ads Management

* Plan, execute, and optimize campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.
* Manage lead generation, website conversion, sales, remarketing, engagement, and awareness campaigns.
* Develop audience strategies using interest targeting, custom audiences, lookalike audiences, and retargeting where appropriate.
* Set up campaign structures, placements, budgets, bidding strategies, and conversion objectives.
* Collaborate with creative teams to develop effective ad concepts, messaging, formats, hooks, and calls to action.
* Monitor campaign fatigue, frequency, CTR, CPM, CPL, CPA, and conversion rates.
* Conduct A/B tests for creatives, audiences, copy, landing pages, and campaign settings.
* Optimize lead quality and conversion performance rather than focusing only on lead volume.
* Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns while controlling acquisition costs.

4. LinkedIn Ads Management

* Plan and manage LinkedIn advertising campaigns for B2B clients.
* Develop targeting strategies based on industry, company size, job title, seniority, function, and relevant professional audiences.
* Manage Lead Gen Forms, website conversion campaigns, sponsored content, and other suitable campaign formats.
* Support B2B lead generation, account-based marketing initiatives, and high-value customer acquisition.
* Monitor lead quality, cost per lead, engagement, and conversion performance.
* Coordinate with client sales teams to understand lead quality and improve campaign targeting.
* Optimize campaigns based on business outcomes and the quality of leads generated.

5. E-commerce & Shopping Ads

* Plan and manage paid campaigns focused on online sales and revenue growth.
* Manage Google Shopping and Performance Max campaigns for eligible e-commerce businesses.
* Coordinate product feed optimization, Merchant Center diagnostics, product categorization, and product-level performance analysis.
* Develop product segmentation and budget allocation strategies based on margins, demand, inventory, and sales performance.
* Monitor ROAS, CPA, average order value, conversion rate, and revenue contribution.
* Identify high-performing products and campaigns for scaling.
* Coordinate with website and e-commerce teams to improve landing pages, checkout experiences, and conversion rates.

6. Conversion Tracking & Analytics

* Set up and validate conversion tracking using Google Ads, Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager.
* Work with developers to implement tracking for forms, purchases, calls, WhatsApp enquiries, and other relevant conversion actions.
* Understand and troubleshoot tracking discrepancies, attribution issues, and conversion measurement errors.
* Monitor campaign performance using GA4, advertising platform dashboards, and reporting tools.
* Use available CRM and sales data to evaluate lead quality, qualified leads, sales conversion, and revenue attribution.
* Ensure that campaign decisions are based on reliable data and properly configured conversion events.
* Understand attribution models, conversion windows, consent requirements, and privacy-conscious measurement practices.

7. Campaign Optimization & Scaling

* Monitor campaign performance regularly and implement data-driven optimization strategies.
* Identify underperforming keywords, audiences, ad sets, placements, creatives, and landing pages.
* Conduct structured experiments to improve campaign efficiency and conversion performance.
* Optimize budgets, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and creative combinations.
* Scale successful campaigns while maintaining target CPL, CPA, ROAS, or other agreed KPIs.
* Diagnose performance fluctuations and recommend corrective measures.
* Identify opportunities to reduce wasted spend and improve advertising account efficiency.
* Maintain a systematic testing and optimization process across client accounts.

8. Landing Page & Conversion Rate Optimization

* Evaluate landing pages for relevance, user experience, messaging consistency, and conversion potential.
* Collaborate with design, content, and web development teams to improve landing page performance.
* Recommend improvements to headlines, forms, calls to action, page structure, loading speed, and mobile experience.
* Analyze conversion funnels and identify drop-off points.
* Support landing page A/B testing and conversion rate optimization initiatives.
* Ensure consistency between advertisements, landing pages, and the client's actual offerings.

9. Budget Management & Financial Accountability

* Manage advertising budgets responsibly across multiple platforms and client accounts.
* Allocate budgets according to campaign performance, business priorities, and growth opportunities.
* Monitor daily and monthly spending to avoid overspending and budget wastage.
* Maintain accurate campaign budget forecasts and expenditure reports.
* Communicate budget requirements, scaling opportunities, and performance risks proactively.
* Ensure campaign spending aligns with client approvals and agreed commercial objectives.

10. Reporting & Client Communication

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly campaign performance reports.
* Present key metrics, performance trends, campaign insights, and optimization recommendations.
* Explain campaign performance, challenges, and corrective actions clearly to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Track campaign KPIs against agreed targets and identify gaps.
* Coordinate with account managers and client servicing teams for updates and approvals.
* Maintain documentation of campaign structures, budgets, experiments, and optimization activities.
* Provide actionable recommendations rather than merely reporting numerical results.

11. Team Collaboration & Ownership

* Coordinate with graphic designers, copywriters, video editors, SEO specialists, social media managers, and web developers.
* Provide clear creative briefs based on audience insights, campaign objectives, and performance data.
* Ensure advertising creatives and landing pages are aligned with campaign requirements.
* Manage multiple client accounts and campaigns simultaneously.
* Take complete ownership of assigned accounts, from strategy and setup to optimization and reporting.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned tasks and maintain high standards of execution.
* Identify and communicate issues proactively instead of waiting for instructions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, or a related field.
* Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in paid advertising or performance marketing preferred.
* Strong practical expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Working experience in LinkedIn Ads and B2B lead generation.
* Knowledge of Google Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube Ads, and e-commerce advertising.
* Experience managing multiple campaigns, advertising accounts, and budgets.
* Strong understanding of keyword research, audience targeting, bidding strategies, remarketing, and campaign optimization.
* Practical knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads conversion tracking, and Meta Pixel.
* Ability to analyze advertising data and make performance-driven decisions.
* Understanding of CPL, CPA, CTR, CPC, CPM, ROAS, CAC, and conversion rate.
* Experience with lead generation funnels, landing pages, and conversion rate optimization.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with e-commerce platforms such as Shopify or WooCommerce.
* Familiarity with CRM systems and offline conversion tracking.
* Experience with B2B marketing, real estate lead generation, or high-ticket services.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Advertising or other relevant advertising platforms.
* Familiarity with Looker Studio and performance reporting dashboards.
* Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications.
* Experience working in a digital marketing agency and managing multiple clients across industries.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on relevant client objectives and agreed targets, including:

* Achievement of target CPL, CPA, ROAS, and conversion goals.
* Quality and business relevance of leads generated.
* Campaign efficiency and responsible budget utilization.
* Improvement in conversion rates and advertising performance.
* Accuracy of tracking, analytics, and reporting.
* Timeliness of campaign launches, optimizations, and deliverables.
* Quality of strategic recommendations and experimentation.
* Client satisfaction, account retention, and proactive communication.
* Ownership, accountability, and consistency in execution.

*KPIs will be defined according to each client's industry, budget, conversion funnel, and business objectives. Results depend on market conditions, offer competitiveness, website performance, and other factors beyond advertising execution.*

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a professional who:

* Can independently handle end-to-end paid advertising campaigns without constant supervision.
* Has strong practical knowledge of multiple advertising platforms.
* Understands the difference between generating leads and generating qualified, revenue-producing leads.
* Can make strategic decisions using campaign data rather than assumptions.
* Is proactive in identifying problems and implementing solutions.
* Takes complete ownership of assigned accounts and budgets.
* Can coordinate effectively with internal teams and clients.
* Is committed to continuous learning and keeping up with changes in advertising platforms.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should share their updated resume along with details of their paid advertising experience, platforms managed, approximate advertising budgets handled, industries served, and measurable campaign results.

Candidates with relevant case studies demonstrating improvements in CPL, ROAS, conversion rates, lead quality, or customer acquisition performance will be preferred.

**We are looking for a hands-on performance marketing professional who can take complete ownership of paid advertising campaigns, manage budgets responsibly, and consistently work toward measurable business outcomes.**

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Experience:

* Google Ad Manager: 4 years (Preferred)
* Facebook Advertising: 4 years (Preferred)
* Twitter Ads: 4 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

**Title and Summary**


Lead Product Manager \- Technical
Who is Mastercard?
  

  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  

  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  

  

Overview
  

  

The Mastercard Dispute Lifecycle team in Pune have an exciting opportunity for a Lead Product Management \- Technical to help further enhance and modernize our Dispute management platform.  

  

The ideal candidate will quickly develop a deep technical understanding of the applications and systems they support, demonstrating a willingness to dive in, challenge assumptions, and ask thoughtful, probing questions to ensure plans are executed effectively and efficiently.  

  

They will bring a strong interest in Payments domain, along with proven technical leadership, and the ability to think creatively applying innovative, out\-of\-the\-box approaches to solve complex problems  

  

Role
  

  

* Customer obsession: Champion a deep understanding of customer needs, the broader ecosystem, and key market dynamics, and embed these insights into product decisions
* Systems analysis \& design: Develop an in\-depth understanding of the product platform and its surrounding ecosystem; produce high\-quality functional artifacts for Engineering, including data flows, sequence diagrams, APIs, and interface specifications
* Backlog management: Define and maintain a clear roadmap aligned to business objectives; translate system designs into well\-structured features and user stories that are ready for Engineering execution
* Story elaboration: Lead refinement sessions and create detailed, comprehensive acceptance criteria to ensure clarity and delivery readiness
* Technical analysis: Provide rigorous analysis of application software to validate that business and functional requirements can be effectively delivered
* Strategic alignment: Partner with stakeholders to ensure backlogs are prioritized and refined based on business value, impact, and measurable outcomes
* Agile mindset: Advocate for and model agile best practices across the product lifecycle—from defining epics to writing actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Continuous improvement: Measure outcomes, evaluate existing practices and metrics, and drive ongoing optimization across processes, roles, and delivery execution

  

All About You
  

  

* Proven product experience: Several years of product management or new product development experience delivering high\-quality products, with the ability to clearly articulate business context and customer use cases
* Technical product expertise: Experience managing highly technical platforms or API\-driven services, with strong software architecture and systems design knowledge
* ISO8583 knowledge (preferred): Familiarity with key payments and dispute management concepts is a plus
* Lean \& Agile delivery: Hands\-on experience with Lean product management and agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), along with CI/CD and modern DevOps practices
* End\-to\-end ownership: Demonstrated success delivering features from design through development, deployment, and customer integration
* Backlog management: Expertise in grooming epics, features, and user stories; defining clear acceptance and exit criteria; and effectively prioritizing platform backlogs
* Data\-driven decision making: Ability to define and leverage SMART metrics (leading and lagging) to guide product strategy and measure success
* Collaboration \& stakeholder management: Proven ability to work across global, cross\-functional teams, align diverse perspectives, and manage dependencies and co\-development opportunities
* Thrives in ambiguity: Comfortable navigating uncertainty; proactively identifies solutions, engages the right stakeholders, and drives clarity
* Continuous improvement \& communication: Committed to optimizing team processes for speed, quality, and innovation, with excellent written and verbal communication skills

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
